item.title: Houkago no Maid
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: for
  • 発売日: 2001-10-19
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 放課後のメイド
  • 英語名: Houkago no Maid

あらすじ

One day the protagonist’s little sister and her friend come to him with a strange request.

“We’re starting a ‘Maid Training Club’, so please help us out!”

He can’t turn down his adorable sister or her friend, so he agrees to help them find a teacher to be the club advisor. The homeroom teacher gets angry and refuses, but the art teacher agrees to take on the job. But, under the condition that the protagonist becomes the club president.

  • 英語名: Trouble Witch’s!!

别名

  • Trouble Witches!!

あらすじ

An inexperienced magician has mistakenly sent our hero and Orihime to the dream world. They want to go back to the real world as soon as possible, but it looks like it will take more than a month just to prepare for the ceremony to send them back. Until then, they have to stay with Pastel, the inexperienced magician, who brought them here in the first place.

He feels easy next to her, but he’s also looking forward to his marriage with the engaged girl. This summer will be hot!

item.title: Oshiete Teacher
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: for
  • 発売日: 2000-09-08
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: おしえてティーチャー
  • 英語名: Oshiete Teacher

あらすじ

The protagonist has become a teacher at an all girl’s school, enjoying his life as a teacher and living in a dorm with his students. One day, he saves his female colleague from being assaulted and they end up dating. She proposes to him, and he has until Summer Vacation to give her an answer. He has two weeks to choose a partner from the women he has met so far. All of the ladies have some kind of problem that’s bothering them. Our protagonist faces these problems head-on, sometimes dating the girls, sometimes having sex with them, he comes to gradually understand them. When everything is over, who will be standing by his side?
